title: Cover–Partition Equivalence
The κ-Complete Triangle-Cover Ideal
statement:
Let \(\kappa\) be an infinite cardinal and \(G\) a graph. Define
\[
\mathcal I_\kappa(G)=
\{F\subseteq E(G): tc((V(G),F))\le \kappa\}.
\]
Then \(\mathcal I_\kappa(G)\) is downward closed and closed under unions of at most \(\kappa\) members.

title: Null-Edge Deletion Persistence
statement:
Let \(\kappa\) be infinite. If \(tc(G)>\kappa\) and \(F\in\mathcal I_\kappa(G)\), then
\[
tc(G-F)>\kappa.
\]

title: No Edge-Minimal High-Cover Graph
statement: If \(\kappa\) is infinite and \(tc(G)>\kappa\), then for every edge \(e\in E(G)\), \(tc(G-e)>\kappa\). Thus no graph of triangle-cover number greater than \(\kappa\) is edge-minimal with respect to that property.

title: Small-Vertex Deletion Persistence
statement: Let \(\kappa\) be infinite. If \(tc(G)>\kappa\) and \(X\subseteq V(G)\) has \(|X|\le\kappa\), then \(tc(G-X)>\kappa\).

title: Component Supremum Formula
statement: If \(G\) is the disjoint union of connected components \(G_i\), then \[tc(G)=\sup_i tc(G_i).\]

title: Small-Separator Escape
statement: Let \(\kappa\) be infinite and \(tc(G)>\kappa\). If \(X\subseteq V(G)\) has size at most \(\kappa\), then some connected component of \(G-X\) has triangle-cover number greater than \(\kappa\).

title: Ordered Forward-Link Coloring
statement: Let \(<\) be a well-order of \(V(G)\). For each vertex \(v\), let \(L^+(v)=G[N^+(v)]\), where \(N^+(v)=\{w>v:vw\in E(G)\}\). Then \[tc(G)\le \sup_v \chi(L^+(v)).\]

title: High-Cover Link Extraction in \(K_4\)-Free Graphs
statement: Let \(\kappa\) be infinite and let \(G\) be \(K_4\)-free with \(tc(G)>\kappa\). For every well-order of \(V(G)\), some vertex \(v\) has a triangle-free forward-link graph \(L^+(v)\) with \(\chi(L^+(v))>\kappa\).

title: Successor-Length Forward-Link Tower
statement: Let \(\kappa\) be infinite and \(G\) be \(K_4\)-free with \(tc(G)>\kappa\). Then one can recursively choose \(\kappa^+\) pairwise vertex-disjoint induced cones \(K_1\vee L_\alpha\) with each \(L_\alpha\) triangle-free and \(\chi(L_\alpha)>\kappa\).

title: Stable Certification of Omitted Edges
statement: Let \(G\) be \(K_4\)-free and \(H\subseteq G\) a maximal spanning triangle-free subgraph. For every omitted edge \(xy\in E(G)\setminus E(H)\), the common-neighbor set \(N_H(x)\cap N_H(y)\) is nonempty and stable in \(G\).

title: Common Omitted-Edge Stable Book
statement: Let \(\kappa\) be infinite and \(tc(G)>\kappa\). For any family of at most \(\kappa\) maximal spanning triangle-free subgraphs of \(G\), there is an edge of \(G\) omitted by every member of the family. If \(G\) is \(K_4\)-free, each layer then supplies a nonempty stable common-neighbor page over that same omitted edge.

title: Stable Triangle-Book Sterility
statement: For an edge \(xy\) and a stable set \(W\subseteq N(x)\cap N(y)\), the graph induced by \(\{x,y\}\cup W\) has triangle-cover number at most two.

title: Countable Book-Deletion Persistence
statement: Let \(G\) be \(K_4\)-free with \(tc(G)>\aleph_0\). The union of countably many stable triangle-book supports has countable triangle-cover number, and deleting its vertex set leaves a subgraph of triangle-cover number greater than \(\aleph_0\).

title: ω₁ Disjoint Critical-Cone Packing
statement: If \(G\) is \(K_4\)-free and \(tc(G)>\aleph_0\), then for every function \(f:\omega_1\to\omega\) there are pairwise vertex-disjoint induced cones \(K_1\vee Q_\alpha\) for \(\alpha<\omega_1\), where every \(Q_\alpha\) is finite, triangle-free, vertex-critical, and \(\chi(Q_\alpha)>f(\alpha)\).

title: Conditional ω₁ Cone Packing from Erdős #738
statement: Assume a finite tree \(T\) has the Erdős–Hajnal property that every triangle-free graph of sufficiently large chromatic number contains an induced copy of \(T\). Then every \(K_4\)-free graph of uncountable triangle-cover number contains \(\omega_1\) pairwise vertex-disjoint induced cones over \(T\).
